create_awd_inbound_order.title: Create AWD inbound order
create_awd_inbound_order.description: Creates a draft AWD inbound order with a list of packages for inbound shipment. The operation creates one shipment per order. [Amazon Warehousing and Distribution API]

origin_address.description: Origin address from where the inbound order will be shipped. Fields: addressLine1, addressLine2, addressLine3, city, countryCode, county, district, name, phoneNumber, postalCode, stateOrRegion (required: addressLine1, countryCode, name, stateOrRegion).

packages_to_inbound.description: List of packages to be inbounded. Each item has fields: count, distributionPackage (required: count, distributionPackage).

external_reference_id.description: Reference ID that can be used to correlate the order with partner resources.

preferences.description: Preferences that can be passed in context of an inbound order Fields: destinationRegion.

output.description: createInbound 201 response. A response that contains the reference identifiers for the newly created or updated inbound order. Consists of an order ID and version.

create_awd_outbound_order.title: Create AWD outbound order
create_awd_outbound_order.description: Creates a draft AWD outbound order with the specified products. The API returns the order ID for the newly created order and starts an async validation check on the outbound products. After the validation check, the order status transitions from VALIDATING to ELIGIBLE/INELIGIBLE. [Amazon Warehousing and Distribution API]

order_preferences.description: Order preferences for the outbound order. Each item has fields: orderPreference, orderPreferenceValue (required: orderPreference, orderPreferenceValue).

packages_to_outbound.description: List of packages to be outbound. Each item has fields: count, distributionPackage (required: count, distributionPackage).

products_to_outbound.description: List of product units to be outbound. Each item has fields: attributes, quantity, sku, expiration, prepDetails (required: quantity, sku).

output.description: The 201 response for createOutbound. A response that contains the reference identifier for the newly created or updated outbound order. This includes an order ID.

create_awd_replenishment_order.title: Create AWD replenishment order
create_awd_replenishment_order.description: Creates an AWD replenishment order with given products to replenish. The order status will transition to ELIGIBLE/INELIGIBLE status from VALIDATING post validation check. [Amazon Warehousing and Distribution API]

preferences.description: Preferences that can be passed in context of a replenishment order Fields: confirmation.

products.description: Requested amount of single product units to be replenished. Each item has fields: attributes, quantity, sku (required: quantity, sku).

output.description: CreateReplenishmentOrder 201 response. Response containing the reference identifier for the newly created/updated replenishment order consisting of the order ID.

get_awd_inbound_shipment_labels.title: Get AWD inbound shipment labels

format_type.description: The format type of the output file that contains your labels. The default format type is PDF.

get_awd_label_page_types.title: Get AWD label page types
get_awd_label_page_types.description: Retrieves the available label page types for a shipment ID that you specify. This is an asynchronous operation. If the label status is GENERATED, then the pageTypes are available. [Amazon Warehousing and Distribution API]

output.description: The 200 response for getLabelPageTypes. Shipment label page types.

get_awd_replenishment_order.title: Get AWD replenishment order

updated_after.description: List the inbound shipments that were updated after a certain time (inclusive). The date must be in ISO 8601 format.

updated_before.description: List the inbound shipments that were updated before a certain time (inclusive). The date must be in ISO 8601 format.

list_awd_inventory.description: Lists AWD inventory associated with a merchant with the ability to apply optional filters. [Amazon Warehousing and Distribution API]

details.description: Set to SHOW to return summaries with additional inventory details. Defaults to HIDE, which returns only inventory summary totals.

next_token.description: A token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. The response includes nextToken when the number of results exceeds the specified maxResults value. output.description: The 200 response for listInventory. AWD inventory payload.

list_awd_outbound_orders.description: Retrieves all outbound AWD orders (with optional filters) that pertain to a merchant. By default, orders are sorted by the updatedAt attribute in descending order. [Amazon Warehousing and Distribution API]

updated_before.description: Get the outbound orders updated before a certain time (inclusive). The date must be in ISO 8601 format.

updated_before.description: Get the replenishment orders updated before certain time (Inclusive) Date should be in ISO 8601 format as defined by date-time in - https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339.

output.description: ListReplenishmentOrders 200 response A list of paginated replenishment orders filtered by the attributes passed in the request.

update_awd_inbound_order.title: Update AWD inbound order
update_awd_inbound_order.description: Updates an AWD inbound order that is in DRAFT status and not yet confirmed. Use this operation to update the packagesToInbound, originAddress and preferences attributes. [Amazon Warehousing and Distribution API]

order_id.description: The ID of the inbound order that you want to update.

created_at.description: Date when this order was created.

packages_to_inbound.description: List of packages to be inbounded. Each item has fields: count, distributionPackage (required: count, distributionPackage).

update_awd_inbound_shipment_transport_de.description: Updates transport details for an AWD shipment. [Amazon Warehousing and Distribution API]

tracking_details.description: Tracking details for the shipment. If using SPD transportation, this can be for each case. If not using SPD transportation, this is a single tracking entry for the entire shipment. Each item has fields: carrierCode, bookingId (required: bookingId).

products_to_outbound.description: List of product units to be outbound. Each item has fields: attributes, quantity, sku, expiration, prepDetails (required: quantity, sku).

get_inventory_summaries.description: Returns a list of inventory summaries. granularity_id.description: The granularity ID for the inventory aggregation level.

marketplace_ids.description: The marketplace ID for the marketplace for which to return inventory summaries. Marketplace ids look like ATVPDKIKX0DER (US), A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2 (CA), A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK), A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE); see the SP-API marketplace id table.

seller_sku.description: A single seller SKU used for querying the specified seller SKU inventory summaries.

create_fulfillment_order.title: Create fulfillment order
create_fulfillment_order.description: Requests that Amazon ship items from the seller's inventory in Amazon's fulfillment network to a destination address. [Fulfillment Outbound API 2020-07-01]

If the seller's system already creates unique order identifiers, then these might be good values for them to use.

displayable_order_id.description: A fulfillment order identifier that the seller creates. This value displays as the order identifier in recipient-facing materials such as the outbound shipment packing slip. displayable_order_date.description: The date and time of the fulfillment order. Displays as the order date in recipient-facing materials such as the outbound shipment packing slip.

displayable_order_comment.description: Order-specific text that appears in recipient-facing materials such as the outbound shipment packing slip.

shipping_speed_category.description: The shipping method for the fulfillment order. When this value is ScheduledDelivery, choose Ship for the fulfillmentAction. Hold is not a valid fulfillmentAction value when the shippingSpeedCategory value is ScheduledDelivery. Note: Shipping method service level agreements vary by marketplace.

destination_address.description: The destination address for the fulfillment order. Fields: name, addressLine1, addressLine2, addressLine3, city, districtOrCounty, stateOrRegion, postalCode, countryCode, phone (required: addressLine1, countryCode, name, postalCode).

items.description: A list of items to include in the fulfillment order preview, including quantity. Maximum of 100 line items with a maximum of 250 units per order. marketplace_id.description: The marketplace the fulfillment order is placed against. Marketplace ids look like ATVPDKIKX0DER (US), A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2 (CA), A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK), A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE); see the SP-API marketplace id table.

delivery_window.description: The time range within which a Scheduled Delivery fulfillment order should be delivered. This is only available in the JP marketplace. Fields: startDate, endDate (required: endDate, startDate).

delivery_preferences.description: The delivery preferences applied to the destination address. These preferences are applied when possible and are best effort. For eligible orders, the default delivery preference is to leave the package unattended at the front door. This feature is currently supported only in the JP marketplace and not applicable for other marketplaces. Fields: deliveryInstructions, dropOffLocation.

fulfillment_action.description: Specifies whether the fulfillment order should ship now or have an order hold put on it.

fulfillment_policy.description: The FulfillmentPolicy value specified when you called the createFulfillmentOrder operation.

cod_settings.description: The COD (Cash On Delivery) charges that you associate with a COD fulfillment order. Fields: isCodRequired, codCharge, codChargeTax, shippingCharge, shippingChargeTax (required: isCodRequired).

ship_from_country_code.description: The two-character country code for the country from which the fulfillment order ships. Must be in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

notification_emails.description: A list of email addresses that the seller provides that are used by Amazon to send ship-complete notifications to recipients on behalf of the seller.

feature_constraints.description: A list of features and their fulfillment policies to apply to the order. Each item has fields: featureName, featureFulfillmentPolicy.

payment_information.description: An array of various payment attributes related to this fulfillment order. This property is required if the order is placed against the India marketplace. Each item has fields: paymentTransactionId, paymentMode, paymentDate (required: paymentTransactionId, paymentMode, paymentDate).

output.description: Success. The response schema for the createFulfillmentOrder operation.

create_fulfillment_return.title: Create fulfillment return
create_fulfillment_return.description: Creates a fulfillment return. [Fulfillment Outbound API 2020-07-01]

payment_information.description: Payment information for the order. Currently only available in India. Fields: payments.

submit_fulfillment_order_status_update.notes: Sandbox-only operation: use the amazon-selling-partner-beta connector (sandbox host).

seller_fulfillment_order_id.description: The identifier assigned to the item by the seller when the fulfillment order was created.

fulfillment_order_status.description: The current status of the fulfillment order.

update_fulfillment_order.title: Update fulfillment order

seller_fulfillment_order_id.description: The identifier assigned to the item by the seller when the fulfillment order was created.

marketplace_id.description: The marketplace the fulfillment order is placed against. Marketplace ids look like ATVPDKIKX0DER (US), A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2 (CA), A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK), A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE); see the SP-API marketplace id table.

displayable_order_id.description: A fulfillment order identifier that the seller creates. This value displays as the order identifier in recipient-facing materials such as the outbound shipment packing slip. The value of DisplayableOrderId should match the order identifier that the seller provides to the recipient.

displayable_order_date.description: The date and time of the fulfillment order. Displays as the order date in recipient-facing materials such as the outbound shipment packing slip.

displayable_order_comment.description: Order-specific text that appears in recipient-facing materials such as the outbound shipment packing slip.

shipping_speed_category.description: The shipping method used for the fulfillment order. When this value is ScheduledDelivery, choose Ship for the fulfillmentAction. Hold is not a valid fulfillmentAction value when the shippingSpeedCategory value is ScheduledDelivery. Note: Shipping method service level agreements vary by marketplace.

destination_address.description: The destination address for the fulfillment order. Fields: name, addressLine1, addressLine2, addressLine3, city, districtOrCounty, stateOrRegion, postalCode, countryCode, phone (required: addressLine1, countryCode, name, postalCode).

fulfillment_action.description: Specifies whether the fulfillment order should ship now or have an order hold put on it.

fulfillment_policy.description: The FulfillmentPolicy value specified when you called the createFulfillmentOrder operation.

ship_from_country_code.description: The two-character country code for the country from which the fulfillment order ships. Must be in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

notification_emails.description: A list of email addresses that the seller provides that are used by Amazon to send ship-complete notifications to recipients on behalf of the seller.

feature_constraints.description: A list of features and their fulfillment policies to apply to the order. Each item has fields: featureName, featureFulfillmentPolicy.

items.description: A list of items to include in the fulfillment order preview, including quantity. Each item has fields: sellerSku, sellerFulfillmentOrderItemId, quantity, giftMessage, displayableComment, fulfillmentNetworkSku, orderItemDisposition, perUnitDeclaredValue, perUnitPrice, perUnitTax (required: quantity, sellerFulfillmentOrderItemId).

update_outbound_order.title: Update outbound order
update_outbound_order.description: Update and/or request shipment for a fulfillment order with an order hold on it. [Fulfillment Outbound API 2026-07-04]

update_outbound_package.title: Update outbound package
update_outbound_package.description: Update package information for a specific package in a fulfillment order. This is a sandbox-only operation and must be directed to a sandbox endpoint. update_outbound_package.notes: Sandbox-only operation: use the amazon-selling-partner-beta connector (sandbox host).

order_id.description: The ID of the order that contains the package that you want to update.

package_id.description: The ID of the package that you want to update.

status.description: The current status of a package. Possible values: PROCESSING, IN_TRANSIT, DELAYED, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, UNDELIVERABLE, EXPIRED.

fulfillment_service_id.description: The identifier of the fulfillment service used for this operation.

delivery_time.description: The estimated delivery date and time of the package, in ISO 8601 date time format.

tracking.description: Tracking information for the package. Fields: carrier, amazon, dropOffLocation, proofOfDelivery.

get_brazil_shipment_details.description: Returns the shipment details required to issue an invoice for the specified shipment. [Shipment Invoicing API (Brazil)]

submit_brazil_shipment_invoice.title: Submit brazil shipment invoice
submit_brazil_shipment_invoice.description: Submits a shipment invoice document for a given shipment. [Shipment Invoicing API (Brazil)]

content_md5_value.description: MD5 sum for validating the invoice data. For more information about calculating this value, see Working with Content-MD5 Checksums.

marketplace_id.description: An Amazon marketplace identifier. Marketplace ids look like ATVPDKIKX0DER (US), A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2 (CA), A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK), A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE); see the SP-API marketplace id table.

output.description: Success. The response schema for the submitInvoice operation.

cancel_feed.title: Cancel feed
cancel_feed.description: Cancels the feed that you specify. Only feeds with processingStatus=IN_QUEUE can be cancelled. Cancelled feeds are returned in subsequent calls to the getFeed and getFeeds operations. [Feeds API 2021-06-30]

feed_id.description: The identifier for the feed. This identifier is unique only in combination with a seller ID.

output.description: The Feeds API 2021-06-30 response for this operation (see the SP-API reference for its shape).

create_feed.title: Create feed
create_feed.description: Creates a feed. Upload the contents of the feed document before calling this operation. Call create_feed_document and upload the content first; poll get_feed for the processing status and read results with get_feed_document. [Feeds API 2021-06-30]

marketplace_ids.description: A list of identifiers for marketplaces that you want the feed to be applied to. Marketplace ids look like ATVPDKIKX0DER (US), A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2 (CA), A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK), A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE); see the SP-API marketplace id table.

input_feed_document_id.description: The document identifier returned by the createFeedDocument operation. Upload the feed document contents before calling the createFeed operation.

feed_options.description: Additional options to control the feed. These vary by feed type.

output.description: Success. Response schema.

create_feed_document.title: Create feed document
create_feed_document.description: Creates a feed document for the feed type that you specify. This operation returns a presigned URL for uploading the feed document contents. It also returns a feedDocumentId value that you can pass in with a subsequent call to the createFeed operation. Returns feedDocumentId and a pre-signed url: upload the feed content there with an HTTP PUT (outside this tool), then call create_feed with the feedDocumentId. [Feeds API 2021-06-30]

content_type.description: The content type of the feed.

output.description: Successfully created a feed document that is ready to receive contents. Information required to upload a feed document's contents.

get_feed.title: Get feed
get_feed.description: Returns feed details (including the resultDocumentId, if available) for the feed that you specify. [Feeds API 2021-06-30]

feed_id.description: The identifier for the feed. This identifier is unique only in combination with a seller ID.

output.description: Success. Detailed information about the feed.

get_feed_document.title: Get feed document
get_feed_document.description: Returns the information required for retrieving a feed document's contents. Returns a pre-signed url for the feed or its processing report; the file itself is not fetched. [Feeds API 2021-06-30]

feed_document_id.description: The identifier of the feed document.

enable_content_encoding_url_header.description: When true, the Content-Encoding header on the returned URL is set to gzip instead of the default identity when compressionAlgorithm is GZIP. This allows automatic decompression by HTTP clients.

output.description: Success. Information required for the feed document.

get_feeds.title: Get feeds
get_feeds.description: Returns feed details for the feeds that match the filters that you specify. [Feeds API 2021-06-30]

feed_types.description: A list of feed types used to filter feeds. When feedTypes is provided, the other filter parameters (processingStatuses, marketplaceIds, createdSince, createdUntil) and pageSize may also be provided. Either feedTypes or nextToken is required.

marketplace_ids.description: A list of marketplace identifiers used to filter feeds. The feeds returned will match at least one of the marketplaces that you specify. Marketplace ids look like ATVPDKIKX0DER (US), A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2 (CA), A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK), A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE); see the SP-API marketplace id table.

page_size.description: The maximum number of feeds to return in a single call.

processing_statuses.description: A list of processing statuses used to filter feeds.

created_since.description: The earliest feed creation date and time for feeds included in the response, in ISO 8601 format. The default is 90 days ago. Feeds are retained for a maximum of 90 days.

created_until.description: The latest feed creation date and time for feeds included in the response, in ISO 8601 format. The default is now.

next_token.description: A string token returned in the response to your previous request. nextToken is returned when the number of results exceeds the specified pageSize value. To get the next page of results, call the getFeeds operation and include this token as the only parameter. Specifying nextToken with any other parameters will cause the request to fail.

output.description: Success. Response schema.

get_finance_summary.title: Get finance summary
get_finance_summary.description: Retrieve the financial summary for the specified time period or settlement period. [Finances API 2024-06-19]

marketplace_ids.description: The marketplaces from which to retrieve summaries. If omitted, summaries from all applicable marketplaces may be returned. To find the marketplace ID for a region, refer to Marketplace IDs. account_type.description: The type of account to include in the response.

related_identifier_name.description: The name of the relatedIdentifier. The only possible value is SETTLEMENT_ID, the settlement ID associated with the summary.

period_start.description: The start of the period for which to retrieve summaries. When provided, the response will only include summaries with transactions that occurred on or after the specified date. The value must be formatted in ISO 8601 date format.

period_end.description: The end of the period for which to retrieve summaries. When provided, the response will only include summaries with transactions that occurred on or before the specified date. The value must be formatted in ISO 8601 date format.

next_token.description: A token that you use to retrieve subsequent pages of results. When there are more results available, the response will include a nextToken value. To get the next page of results, call the operation with this token and include the same arguments as the call that produced the token.

output.description: Success. The response to the listSummary operation.

list_finance_balances.title: List finance balances
list_finance_balances.description: Retrieve a balance. This balance can be a past balances at a specified date, or a current balance. Sub-balances are listed by account type and marketplace. [Finances API 2024-06-19]

marketplace_ids.description: The marketplaces from which to retrieve balances. If omitted, balances from all applicable marketplaces may be returned. To find the marketplace ID for a region, refer to Marketplace IDs. Marketplace ids look like ATVPDKIKX0DER (US), A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2 (CA), A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK), A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE); see the SP-API marketplace id table.

list_financial_event_groups.title: List financial event groups
list_financial_event_groups.description: Returns financial event groups for a given date range. Orders from the last 48 hours might not be included in financial events. [Finances API v0]

max_results_per_page.description: The maximum number of results per page. If the response exceeds the maximum number of transactions or 10 MB, the response is InvalidInput.

financial_event_group_started_before.description: A date that selects financial event groups that opened before (but not at) a specified date and time, in ISO 8601 format. The date-time must be after FinancialEventGroupStartedAfter and more than two minutes before the time of request.

next_token.description: The response includes nextToken when the number of results exceeds the specified pageSize value. list_financial_events.title: List financial events
list_financial_events.description: Returns financial events for the specified data range. Orders from the last 48 hours might not be included in financial events. Note: in ListFinancialEvents, deferred events don't show up in responses until they are released. [Finances API v0]

max_results_per_page.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. If the response exceeds the maximum number of transactions or 10 MB, the response is InvalidInput.

posted_after.description: The response includes financial events posted after (or on) this date. This date must be in ISO 8601 date-time format. The date-time must be more than two minutes before the time of the request.

posted_before.description: The response includes financial events posted before (but not on) this date. This date must be in ISO 8601 date-time format. next_token.description: The response includes nextToken when the number of results exceeds the specified pageSize value. output.description: The payload for the listFinancialEvents operation.

list_financial_events_by_group_id.title: List financial events by group ID
list_financial_events_by_group_id.description: Returns all financial events for the specified financial event group. Orders from the last 48 hours might not be included in financial events. A request for data spanning more than two years produces an empty response. [Finances API v0]

event_group_id.description: The identifier of the financial event group to which the events belong.

max_results_per_page.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. If the response exceeds the maximum number of transactions or 10 MB, the response is InvalidInput.

posted_after.description: The response includes financial events posted after (or on) this date. This date must be in ISO 8601 date-time format. The date-time must be more than two minutes before the time of the request.

posted_before.description: The response includes financial events posted before (but not on) this date. This date must be in ISO 8601 date-time format. next_token.description: The response includes nextToken when the number of results exceeds the specified pageSize value. output.description: The payload for the listFinancialEvents operation.

list_financial_events_by_order_id.title: List financial events by order ID

max_results_per_page.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. If the response exceeds the maximum number of transactions or 10 MB, the response is InvalidInput.

next_token.description: The response includes nextToken when the number of results exceeds the specified pageSize value. output.description: The payload for the listFinancialEvents operation.

list_financial_transactions.title: List financial transactions

posted_before.description: The response includes financial events posted before (but not on) this date. This date must be in ISO 8601 date-time format. marketplace_id.description: The identifier of the marketplace from which you want to retrieve transactions. The marketplace ID is the globally unique identifier of a marketplace. To find the ID for a marketplace, refer to Marketplace IDs. Marketplace ids look like ATVPDKIKX0DER (US), A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2 (CA), A1F83G8C2ARO7P (UK), A1PA6795UKMFR9 (DE); see the SP-API marketplace id table.

transaction_status.description: The status of the transaction. next_token.description: The response includes nextToken when the number of results exceeds the specified pageSize value. list_finance_invoices.title: List finance invoices
list_finance_invoices.description: Returns invoice headers for all invoices matching filters that you specify. [Finances Invoices API 2026-06-25]

invoices_modified_after.description: Retrieve invoices that were modified after this date-time. In ISO 8601 date-time format.

payment_method_types.description: A comma-separated list of the payment method types you want to include in the response.

output.description: Success. The response schema for the getPaymentMethods operation.

account_type.description: The account type in the selected marketplace for which a payout must be initiated. For supported EU marketplaces, the only account type is Standard Orders.

created_before.description: The response only includes payouts created before this date-time. The value must be formatted in ISO 8601 date-time format. If omitted, no end date filter is applied.

po_item_state.description: Current state of the purchase order item. If this value is Cancelled, this API will return purchase orders which have one or more items cancelled by Amazon with updated item quantity as zero.

is_po_changed.description: When true, returns purchase orders which were modified after the order was placed. Vendors are required to pull the changed purchase order and fulfill the updated purchase order and not the original one. Default value is false.

purchase_order_state.description: Filters purchase orders based on the purchase order state.

ordering_vendor_code.description: Filters purchase orders based on the specified ordering vendor code. This value should be same as 'sellingParty.partyId' in the purchase order. created_after.description: Purchase orders that became available after this timestamp will be included in the result. Must be in ISO-8601 date/time format.

created_before.description: Purchase orders that became available before this timestamp will be included in the result. Must be in ISO-8601 date/time format.

updated_after.description: Purchase orders for which the last purchase order update happened after this timestamp will be included in the result. Must be in ISO-8601 date/time format.

updated_before.description: Purchase orders for which the last purchase order update happened before this timestamp will be included in the result. Must be in ISO-8601 date/time format.

ship_to_party_id.description: Filters purchase orders for a specific buyer's Fulfillment Center/warehouse by providing ship to location id here.
